view: Uxmal Governor Palace close oblique architectural study along limestone facade, plain lower wall rectangular dark doorways, richly intricate continuous upper Puuc mosaic frieze with geometric lattice and projecting long-nosed Chaac masks, low terrace foreground. No fantasy giant masks or glyph writing, no pyramid primary subject.

eras.title: Stonework above the doorway
eras.caption: At Uxmal's Governor's Palace, plain lower walls support a long band of intricate stone mosaic. Geometric patterns and masks turn the upper façade into a carefully fitted surface, a distinctive feature of Puuc architecture.
